verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a Private Cloud offering: a dedicated, isolated, managed private instance on AWS or Azure, chosen to meet data-residency requirements, with Azure's 60+ regions available for storing customer data. This delivers the story's 'private instance' option and gives control over where user data lives. Missing for 10: any self-managed or self-hosted deployment (Private Cloud is still operated by Auth0); documentation of keeping user data permanently in your own database (custom database connections are evidenced only as a migration path); independent or hands-on corroboration of Private Cloud.
